name: What does kitchen cabinet removal involve?

mainEntity.name: What does kitchen cabinet removal involve?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen cabinet removal is the process of safely detaching and dismantling existing kitchen cabinetry from walls and preparing the space for new installations or renovations. This typically includes emptying cabinets, disconnecting plumbing (if integrated into sink bases), detaching units from wall studs and adjacent cabinets, and carefully lowering them. Proper removal minimizes damage to walls and flooring, ensuring a smooth transition for your next kitchen phase. It also involves responsible disposal of the old cabinets.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen cabinet removal involves safely detaching and dismantling existing cabinetry from walls, preparing the space for new installations, and responsible disposal.
